summary: Relay Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a material definitive agreement — an underwritten public offering of 22,916,667 shares of common stock at $12.00 per share, with a fully exercised 30-day over-allotment for an additional 3,437,500 shares. Net proceeds are estimated at ~$296.8 million. The offering is made under an existing shelf registration statement (Form S-3ASR) and is expected to close May 22, 2026. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation. Underwriters are Jefferies and TD Securities. No special-situation dynamics or event-driven price dislocation is involved.
